 "content": "from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    divider = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 5 for v in row))
    above = Counter(v for row in grid[:divider] for v in row if v not in (0, 5))
    below = Counter(v for row in grid[divider + 1:] for v in row if v not in (0, 5))
    colors = set(above) | set(below)
    color = max(colors, key=lambda c: below[c] - above[c])
    return [[color, color], [color, color]]
"
